findings.title: Ridhano wordmark is mirrored (flipped left to right)
findings.explanation: Logos, wordmarks, icons and characters may be resized and placed, but never stretched, squashed, skewed or mirrored. Scale both sides together. Compared with official wordmark 'Ridhano wordmark', this copy is mirrored (flipped left to right).

findings.title: Unapproved additions to Ridhano wordmark: parts joined to it
findings.explanation: Only the approved parts of a mascot or logo may be used. Adding a body, outfit, pose or features the brand has not approved creates an unofficial character. The brand has approved official wordmark 'Ridhano wordmark' as wordmark only; this image adds parts joined to it.

findings.title: Text under the instagram buttons: “New season, new”
findings.explanation: Full-screen instagram covers roughly the top 14%, bottom 22% and right 12% of the frame with its own controls and caption. On vertical video and full-screen posts the app overlays its own buttons and caption at the edges. Text under them can't be read.
